pages.text: The $(d)Lay Egg$() Gene causes entities to $(9)spawn an Egg$() every so often.$(br2)This time is configurable, but defaults to once every 5 minutes. $(br2)This Gene $(9)can be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)4/10 - Chicken$(br)4/17 - Parrot
